situations.name: one-turn
situations.what: A turn meets the limit, the selector finds an account, the turn goes on

situations.name: nobody-asked
situations.what: A turn that is not the pool's, a turn of another trace, a pool without a selector

situations.name: two-running
situations.what: Two turns run, one meets the limit: both are stopped, and both go on

situations.name: joined
situations.what: A second turn meets the limit while the first one's recovery is under way

situations.name: no-account
situations.what: No account serves: asked again every minute, and after half an hour the turns run and fail

situations.name: found-at-the-half-hour
situations.what: An account is found at the pass that would have let the turns go: they are taken up

situations.name: no-answer
situations.what: The selector gives no answer, then cannot be run, then finds an account

situations.name: too-early
situations.what: A timer that comes before the next check is due asks nobody

situations.name: arrives-meanwhile
situations.what: A turn that is to start during a recovery waits with the others

situations.name: unchecked-model
situations.what: A turn of another model arrives while the selector runs: one more whole check

situations.name: stopped-by-its-user
situations.what: The only waiting turn is stopped by its user: the recovery ends

situations.name: stopped-while-asked
situations.what: A waiting turn is stopped while the selector runs: it is not taken up

situations.name: over-while-asked
situations.what: A waiting turn is over while the selector runs

situations.name: some-models
situations.what: The account now active serves one model of two: those turns go on, the others wait

situations.name: none-of-them
situations.what: The account now active serves none of the models asked for, or others

situations.name: held-without-hold
situations.what: A turn that cannot be told it is held is paused

situations.name: its-own-half-hour
situations.what: A turn that waits for its model while the pool works runs after its own half hour, and proves the model for the others

situations.name: trial-fails
situations.what: The turn released at its half hour meets the limit again: it ends, the others wait on

situations.name: trial-stopped
situations.what: The turn released at its half hour is stopped by its user: it proves nothing, the others wait on

situations.name: trial-too-young
situations.what: A trial that has not run a minute proves nothing yet

situations.name: served-by-someone
situations.what: Someone else changes the login to an account that serves the waiting model

situations.name: served-during
situations.what: Told of another login while a recovery is under way: nothing is done

situations.name: relapse
situations.what: A turn meets the limit again soon after it was taken up: asked later each time, and the fifth ends it

situations.name: relapse-of-another
situations.what: The pool relapses on a turn that was not the one taken up: it is slowed, and never ended

situations.name: quiet-again
situations.what: Ten quiet minutes after a recovery: the next limit is a new one

situations.name: plan-alone
situations.what: The provider says the account does not offer the model, and nothing else runs: the selector is asked three times, then the turn ends with what the provider said

situations.name: plan-served
situations.what: The same, and another account offers the model

situations.name: plan-while-others-work
situations.what: The same while other turns run: nothing is stopped, the turn ends

situations.name: plan-joins
situations.what: The same while a recovery is under way: it waits with the rest, as any turn

situations.name: plan-with-others-waiting
situations.what: A turn parked for its plan among turns parked for the limit: only it ends

situations.name: plan-cannot-end
situations.what: A turn parked for its plan that cannot be ended waits like the others

situations.name: new-turn-after-expiry
situations.what: A turn released at the half hour is not parked again, a new turn of the agent is

situations.name: is-it-parked
situations.what: Whether a turn waits with no process left, asked along the way

situations.name: carried
situations.what: A Host that starts takes up a recovery that was under way, and waits for a turn of it to come back

situations.name: carried-one-back
situations.what: The same, and one turn is back when it first looks: it goes on at once, without the other

situations.name: carried-nothing
situations.what: The same, and nothing comes back at all

situations.name: carried-late
situations.what: A recovery taken up near its half hour ends at its half hour
